prompt:
Kreative Kompas Engine (C++20, Vulkan): R1h moves shader and pipeline creation behind the render hardware interface (docs/plans/rhi.md). rhi::Device has createShaderModule(SPIR-V words) and createGraphicsPipeline(rhi::GraphicsPipelineDesc) (kke/rhi/GraphicsPipeline.h, kke/rhi/Device.h); VulkanGpuDevice (kke/rhi/VulkanDevice.h) implements them on Vulkan. The pipelines must come out exactly as kke::Pipeline's constructor in engine/src/Pipeline.cpp made them before: that code is the reference. Write engine/src/rhi/VulkanPipeline.cpp: VulkanShaderModule's constructor (VkShaderModuleCreateInfo with codeSize = spirv.size() * 4 and pCode = spirv.data(); vkCreateShaderModule on `device` wrapped in VK_CHECK, like loadShaderModule in engine/src/ShaderUtils.cpp), its destructor (vkDestroyShaderModule when m_module is not null) and VulkanGpuDevice::createShaderModule(spirv), which returns std::make_unique<VulkanShaderModule>(m_device.device(), spirv). m_device in VulkanGpuDevice is a kke::VulkanDevice&; include kke/VulkanDevice.h and kke/VulkanCheck.h. No stubs, no exceptions of your own.
Answer with the file's contents only, in one ```cpp fence: no shell commands and no other file.
